## Comparación Chebyshev vs Normal

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5.2

# Valores de k
k <- seq(1.01, 5, length = 500)

# Desigualdad de Chebyshev
chebyshev <- 1 - 1/k^2

# Probabilidad exacta en Normal
normal_prob <- sapply(
  k,
  function(ki) diff(pnorm(c(-ki, ki)))
)

# Configuración gráfica
par(
  mar = c(4.5, 4.5, 3, 1),
  family = "sans"
)

# Base del gráfico
plot(
  k, chebyshev,
  type = "n",
  ylim = c(0,1),
  xlab = "Número de desviaciones estándar (k)",
  ylab = "Probabilidad",
  main = "Desigualdad de Chebyshev vs Distribución Normal",
  cex.main = 1.35,
  cex.lab = 1.15,
  cex.axis = 1.05
)

# Cuadrícula
grid(col = "gray90")

# Área Chebyshev
polygon(
  c(k, rev(k)),
  c(chebyshev, rep(0, length(k))),
  col = adjustcolor("#fecaca", alpha.f = 0.45),
  border = NA
)

# Área Normal
polygon(
  c(k, rev(k)),
  c(normal_prob, rep(0, length(k))),
  col = adjustcolor("#bfdbfe", alpha.f = 0.35),
  border = NA
)

# Curvas
lines(
  k, chebyshev,
  lwd = 4,
  col = "#991b1b"
)

lines(
  k, normal_prob,
  lwd = 4,
  col = "#1e3a8a",
  lty = 2
)

# Líneas de referencia
abline(
  h = c(0.68, 0.95, 0.997),
  col = "gray70",
  lty = 3
)

# Etiquetas 68-95-99.7
text(
  x = 4.7,
  y = c(0.68, 0.95, 0.997),
  labels = c("68%", "95%", "99.7%"),
  cex = 0.9,
  col = "gray40",
  pos = 3
)

# Puntos destacados
k_pts <- c(2,3)

points(
  k_pts,
  1 - 1/k_pts^2,
  pch = 19,
  cex = 1.4,
  col = "#991b1b"
)

points(
  k_pts,
  sapply(k_pts,
         function(ki) diff(pnorm(c(-ki, ki)))),
  pch = 19,
  cex = 1.4,
  col = "#1e3a8a"
)

# Leyenda
legend(
  "bottomright",
  legend = c(
    "Chebyshev (cualquier distribución)",
    "Distribución Normal"
  ),
  col = c("#991b1b", "#1e3a8a"),
  lwd = 4,
  lty = c(1,2),
  pt.cex = 1.2,
  bty = "n",
  cex = 1
)

# Caja
box(col = "gray40")
```
